Name: Wedding Anniversaries
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[i][size=5]"Why doesn't my Stardew spouse remember our wedding anniversary?"[/size][/i][color=#f4cccc][i][size=5]
[/size][/i]
[b][size=5]Well, now they can!
[/size]
[/b][/color][b][size=4]UPDATE: This mod just got a huge update! Multiple spouses now supported, along with all existing spouses and custom NPCs.[/size][/b]

[size=3]v2.0: Adds Content Patcher support for any mod that would like to add custom anniversary dialogue for their NPC.
[/size]
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]What This Mod Does:
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]This is a dialogue mod that creates special marriage dialogue for each spouse on the day of their wedding anniversary.

NPC spouses will now:
[list]
[*][size=3]Remind the player of an upcoming anniversary one week in advance[/size]
[*]Wish the player a happy anniversary and give an [color=#f4cccc][b]anniversary gift[/b][/color]
[*]If the spouse is happy with the player (10+ hearts) on the day of the wedding anniversary, you will see unique randomized dialogue for each vanilla spouse and a custom randomized [b][color=#f4cccc]anniversary gift.[/color] [/b]Each spouse has a different set of gifts to give!
[*]However, if the spouse is unhappy with the player (fewer than 10 hearts), the dialogue and the anniversary gift will both be... less nice.
[/list][/size]
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Known Issues:
[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3]While this mod has proven very robust during testing, there is a slight possibility that messing around with console commands like [b]world_setyear[/b] (etc) will change a spouse's wedding date in the save file. This will obviously cause the anniversary text to not happen on the correct day, possibly skipping year 1 entirely. You have been warned.[/size]
[/list]
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Spouse Gift Lists: [/b][/size]
[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3258][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3258
[/size][/url]
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Compatibility With Other Mods:
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]This mod should work with any marriageable NPC. There are default dialogue and gifts lists for non-vanilla spouses, so you should get an anniversary day greeting from custom NPCs with no issues. However, if you would like to add special wedding anniversary text to your mod, feel free to check out the github for details on how to make that happen:

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Kantrip-Mods/SDV/tree/main/WeddingAnniversaries]Github -- Wedding Anniversaries[/url]﻿﻿
[/list][/size][b][color=#f4cccc][size=5]
Recommended Mods:[/size][/color][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8351][color=#f4cccc][size=5]
[/size][/color][size=3]﻿Anniversary on Calendar:[/size][/url][size=3] a nice quality-of-life mod that puts the anniversary right on the community calendar for a little bit of extra immersion. Not required, but nice.
